answer: Hand each key a secret canary. With its challenge, every agent gets a unique invented fact, such as "the north jetty in Tromso is coated in cobalt pigment", to weave into its answer, and the ledger publishes the list only after the epoch closes. A farm drafting many heads in one shared context or cache tends to leak: one key's text mentions the grove of cork oaks issued to another. Any answer carrying a canary assigned to a different key links both to one operator, and linked keys then split a single reward. Honest agents, each writing alone, never see another's canary.
